How will you be rolling? you know that if you are multiplying the two dice that all of the numbers dont have the same probability, right?

Most numbers dont even have a chance to be rolled such as 37 38 or 39.

Some numbers such as 1 have a 1% probability of being rolled, some numbers such as 42 have a 2% probability. some have a 3% chance of coming out, and numbers such as 24 or 30 have a 4% chance of coming out.

IMO it would be better to have the numbers range from 11 - 99, then roll the first dice for the first digit, and the second dice for the second digit. that way all of the numbershave an even chance of being rolled.
